name: source-list
title: Source List
description: The web pages an answer cites, numbered as its [[n]] markers: "Sources · 3 ›" with the first sites' icons, opening to one-line rows (number, site icon on a light tile in dark, title, site, ↗); SourceCard is the card a [[n]] pill opens, and sourceCitations wires the list into MarkdownView.

meta.whenToUse: Web search results an agent's answer cites, under the answer, and the cards its [[n]] pills open.
meta.whenNotToUse: The person's own things such as a Doc, a Meet or a pull request (ResourcePill), records cited by a summary (CitedList), or search results the agent looked at but didn't cite (the work log).
